description: This is a PHP source file defining the PurgeDao class within the OrangeHRM system, which handles database operations related to employee data purging.

classes.name: PurgeDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for querying and managing employee purge operations in the database.

methods.name: isEmployeePurgeable
methods.description: Checks if an employee identified by employee number can be purged, based on termination record presence and purged status.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves employee or related entity data from the database based on employee number and optional join information.
